# kubesense_integration (Resource)

A platform integration: Jira, Confluence, Atlassian, or a custom MCP server. KubeSense tests the connection on every create and on every change to credentials or config, and refuses the change when the test fails.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "kubesense_integration" "jira" {
  integration_provider = "jira"
  name                 = "jira-prod"
  api_key              = var.jira_api_token
  config = {
    deployment = "cloud"
    base_url   = "https://acme.atlassian.net"
    username   = "kubesense-bot@acme.com"
  }
}

# A remote MCP server with its key in a custom header.
resource "kubesense_integration" "runbooks" {
  integration_provider = "custom"
  name                 = "runbooks-mcp"
  api_key              = var.runbooks_mcp_key
  auth_scheme          = "header"
  auth_header          = "X-API-Key"
  config = {
    deployment    = "remote"
    url           = "https://mcp.acme.internal/sse"
    extra_headers = jsonencode({ "X-Tenant" = "acme" })
  }
}

variable "jira_api_token" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}

variable "runbooks_mcp_key" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `config` (Map of String) Connection settings, including deployment (cloud, cloud_service_account, datacenter, or remote for custom). Jira and Confluence take base_url and, for basic auth, username; custom takes url and extra_headers = jsonencode({...}). The whole map is sent on every change.
- `integration_provider` (String) One of jira, confluence, atlassian or custom (an MCP server). Changing it replaces the integration. GitHub connects only through the UI.
- `name` (String) Name, unique per provider.

### Optional

- `api_key` (String, Sensitive) API token or password. Write-only on the server: it is never read back, so a change made outside Terraform is not detected, and it is not set on import.
- `auth_header` (String) Header carrying the key when auth_scheme is header (custom MCP servers).
- `auth_scheme` (String) bearer, basic or header. Defaults to what the deployment uses.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the integration is in use.

### Read-Only

- `api_key_hint` (String) The last characters of the stored key.
- `id` (String) Integration id.
- `integration_type` (String) native or mcp.
- `status` (String) pending, healthy or error, from the last connection test.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# api_key is not imported; set it in the configuration before the next apply.
terraform import kubesense_integration.jira 0d6f4a8e-2b1c-4f7a-9e3d-5c8b7a6f1e20
```
